logo:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: finished title wordmark for the original cozy airship adventure game Cloudstitch.
Primary request: one beautiful emotionally warm HAND-LETTERED logo on a genuinely transparent background, matching a hand-painted cream canvas airship with teal metal, honey-colored wood, brass fittings and a coral fabric patch.
Text (verbatim): "Cloudstitch". Spell exactly C-l-o-u-d-s-t-i-t-c-h, capital C and lowercase remaining letters, one uninterrupted readable word, no other text.
Style/medium: carefully drawn storybook ink and matte gouache lettering, a bespoke gently rounded soft serif wordmark, lively but restrained human irregularities, elegant rather than childish, strong legibility at small size.
Color palette: deep desaturated petrol-teal contours, warm ivory letter faces, very restrained ochre-gold stitching and a tiny muted coral detail.
Composition/framing: a single horizontal wordmark centered, nearly full width, generous transparent breathing room. A tiny embroidered cloud and a curved sewing thread integrated above or around the C and final h may accompany the word; minimal airy ornament. Subtle internal painted pigment, clean closed readable letter shapes. Flat illustration intended to overlay an airy sky; minimal narrow shadow only around lettering.
Constraints: actually transparent PNG alpha outside the mark; one logo only, no presentation board, no white rectangle, no checkerboard illustration, no photographed paper, no mockup, no 3D bevel, no glossy plastic, no huge crest, no ribbon, no unrelated slogans, no watermark. Do not include a full airship illustration.
title_background:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: wide 16:9 finished background art for the title screen of the original emotional airship game Cloudstitch; UI will be overlaid separately.
Input image 1: airship IDENTITY and hand-drawn material/style reference, NOT a background to preserve. Create a new wider illustrated scene with this same recognizable ship.
Scene/backdrop: a quiet open sky above a softly rolling sea of clouds at warm early morning, distant pale blue floating land silhouettes far below, a few faraway mooring structures dissolve in mist. Vast peaceful space with a sense of homeward adventure. A hand-painted watercolor and gouache animation-background sensibility with delicate pencil/ink contours and visible subtle pigment texture, original artwork.
Subject: keep the reference airship design strongly faithful: one large long cream fabric balloon with stitched seams, two chestnut leather straps and brass buckles, coral triangular repair patch on the front right side; small honey wooden open-deck hull; small teal-roof cabin with round brass porthole at stern-left; large teal rear propeller; hanging rope winch and curved salvage hook; one small dark deck-mounted gun at the bow-right. The ship points right and is seen from a gentle slightly elevated three-quarter side view. Whole balloon, hull, propeller and hook visible, coherent believable structure.
Composition/framing: wide landscape 16:9. Airship occupies the RIGHT half, approximately x=56%-95%, y=28%-76%, so the ship is big enough to admire but not cropped. LEFT 43% is a calm LIGHT warm ivory-blue sky area with broad subtle cloud washes and minimal fine detail, deliberately usable for a separately composited logo and four vertical menu items. Do not paint any lettering, logo, icons, menus or UI. No foreground architecture covering the ship.
Lighting/mood: tender morning sunlight, ivory canvas glowing softly, teal and honey-wood in gentle cel-like painted shadows, apricot edges on some clouds, wistful and inviting, a repaired flying home rather than a toy or ominous warship. The gun is a small inherited utility detail, not firing. Quiet wind indicated by a small fabric streamer; no people or added animal characters.
Constraints: 2D hand-painted art with convincing volume, clean reference-faithful silhouette, simplified shading instead of realistic rendering, clear wing/propeller shapes. Avoid photorealism, plastic CGI, excessive steampunk clutter, huge castles replacing the boat, additional balloons, extra cabins, neon colors, dramatic fire, combat, illegible marks, text and watermarks. One complete illustration, no moodboard panels.
